description.summary: A bright, blue light swirls about its target, removing the vast majority of lesser negative status effects inflicted upon them.
description.value: A bright, blue light swirls about its target, removing the vast majority of lesser negative status effects inflicted upon them. The target is relieved of all of the following status effects: Blinded , Charmed , Cowering , Dazed , Dazzled , Deafened , Deprotect , Deshell , Diseased , Entangled , Exhausted , Fatigued , Frightened , Immobilized , Imperil , Nauseated , Panicked , Paralyzed , Petrification , Poisoned , Sapped , Shaken , Sickened , Silenced , Sleep , Slow , and Staggered .
